Ava: Quick plan for the benchmark webinar launch next Tue. Goal: single primary invite + 2 nurture reminders, APAC-friendly send windows, and automated SDR routing. Need segment rules, subject variants, and a low-open fallback. :rocket:
Noah: Suggest cohort waterfall: Engagers -> Trialers -> Newsletter. Prioritize Engagers for first send.
Priya: Draft segments: Engagers = clicked benchmark content in last 45d; Trialers = trial started in last 30d but low feature usage; Newsletter = all subscribers excluding the other two. Omar can export.
Omar: Routing plan: high-intent (engagers OR trialers who viewed pricing) -> SDR-A; everything else -> SDR-B. TTL for routing events: 48h. We'll include `x-sdr-route` in webhook.
Ava: Good. Use SendGrid webhook to attach `x-sdr-route:A|B` and `email_stage:invite|reminder|dayof`. mel-marketingbot, will you validate?
mel-marketingbot: Initial checks: template compiles, CTAs present. Found stale footer link (/docs -> /docs/getting-started). Marked for fix.
Priya: Subject line A/B test: A: "Join our live benchmark: real numbers, live Q&A" B: "Live benchmark: latency, cost, and tradeoffs" Preview text: "See model configs, perf breakdowns, and the Q&A"
Noah: Timing proposal: Engagers Tue 10:00 PT / 18:00 GMT, Trialers Wed 09:00 PT, Newsletter Thu 08:00 PT (better APAC reach).
Ava: Nurture cadence: Invite -> Reminder 72h before -> Day-of (2h before). If opens are low after day-of, switch to a short case-study drip (2 emails over next week).
Omar: Export SQL for Engagers: ```SELECT user_id FROM events WHERE event IN ('click','download') AND ref IN ('benchmark-report','benchmark-webinar') AND occurred_at > now() - interval '45 days'``` Will push CSV to the campaign folder.
Priya: Tracking rules: add utm_campaign=benchmark-webinar-2026 and utm_content=variantA|variantB. Also set `email_stage` meta for all sends.
Ava: Add rollback rule: if overall CTR < 0.8% after 24h, pause reminders and send one concise product highlight to everyone. Noah, can you add to the playbook?
Noah: Yep, adding automatic rule and a short fallback template. Also will include analytics check for opens, CTR, and registration conversions at 12h and 24h.
Priya: Personalization: for Trialers first line include `{{top_feature_used}}` fallback to "your trial". Keeps copy tight and relevant.
Ava: Action items: Omar export lists + add route tags by EOD tomorrow; Priya finalize A/B copy and preview text; Noah add rollback/playbook checks; mel-marketingbot re-run validation after fixes. I'll create the campaign in SendGrid and share calendar invites. :calendar:
Omar: On it. Will post when CSVs are uploaded.
mel-marketingbot: Re-run scheduled 2026-03-11T16:00:00Z. Will post results to this thread. :white_check_mark:
